source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part A (Ferrous Material Specifications), Volume 2 — SA/EN 10222-2 - Specification for Steel Forgings for Pressure Purposes Part 2: Ferritic and Martensitic Steels with Specified Elevated Temperature Properties — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.A-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

(Identical with International Specification EN 10222-2:2017+A1:2021 with these additional requirements.)
1.1 General Requirements: All"see EN10222-1" shall be read as "shall be according to EN 10222-1."
(a) In addition to the marking requirements of this specification, the marking on products, and the material identification used on all documentation shall include:
• (2) the steel grade or number

(3) heat treatment condition as described below (b) Forgings shall be marked by the party performing the heat treatment with the letters designating the applicable heat treatment condition in Table 1 of EN 10222-2 following the stamped steel name or number.
(c) Forgings for which normalizing has been replaced by normalizing forming as permitted by Note c of Table 1 shall be marked as "+NF" instead of "+N".
Note c of Table 2 shall be read as, "If only aluminum is used for nitrogen binding, a ratio of Al/N ≥ 2 shall apply."
In Table A.2a, 1% creep limit properties (for temperatures from 380°C to 500°C), Note c for Grade X16CrMo5-1 shall not apply.
If resurfacing by welding is acceptable by agreement with the purchaser and in accordance with para. 6.7.2.3 of EN 10222-1 the following requirements have to be fulfilled:
(a) Preparation for repair welding shall include inspection to assure complete removal of the defect.

(b) Repairs shall be made utilizing welding procedures qualified in accordance with ASME Section IX and repair welding shall be done by welders or welding operators meeting the qualification requirements of ASME Section IX.
